(Nasdaq: SION), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company on a mission to develop novel medicines for cystic fibrosis (CF), today reported topline data from two nucleotide binding domain 1 (NBD1) stabilizer programs, the PreciSION CF Phase 2a proof-of-concept (POC) trial of SION-719 when added to Trikafta ® (elexacaftor/tezacaftor/ivacaftor) in CF participants, and the Phase 1 trial of SION-451-based proprietary dual combinations in healthy subjects.
The Company received the topline data on Friday, August 7, 2026, and is continuing to analyze the results of the PreciSION CF study.
